reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text: Every day, @canconnects provides vital food, shelter, and housing stability to Baltimore County families when they need it most. #TeamMD02 joined the staff and volunteers to celebrate 60 years of showing up for our neighbors! https://t.co/fHFDb2iqn6
We must deliver. https://t.co/1LhV6HXfS3
We must have a responsible path to citizenship. https://t.co/ofFqPCNUoi
Now I know why he wouldn't answer my questions! https://t.co/y6UJJDVCkI https://t.co/y5BGDSuJEQ

The service members who have served our country deserve support and resources when they return home.

Operation Green Light shows veterans that they are seen and valued. That's why I'm proud to lead this bipartisan effort and am grateful to @NACoCounties and @nacvso_official for making this a nationwide movement.

Today, we honor the courage, dedication, and sacrifice of all who have honorably served our country. On #VeteransDay and every day, we must ensure veterans and their families receive the care, benefits, and opportunities they've earned.

To our veterans: we see you, we thank you, https://t.co/4B3ijCT5On
https://t.co/fBGyc3g043
Just zoomed in on @SamForstag's name tag... https://t.co/Vbt4t4Zfa5 https://t.co/2f59yD6xJ6

Libraries create opportunity for #MD02 communities. Proud to help announce $2 million in federal funding for the new @bcplinfo Essex branch, a project I laid the groundwork for as Baltimore County Executive. https://t.co/9a2mBUL5xs

As I have said before, Secretary Hegseth should resign.

If he doesn't, Trump must fire him.

Otherwise, I will support Hegseth's impeachment. https://t.co/Cz6lZjAC16

Trump is $3 BILLION richer in his second term.

Best two years for his bank account. Not for the American people. https://t.co/adqN9e9T4u

Franchises create jobs, support small businesses, and strengthen our local economy.

I heard firsthand from @Franchising411, Huffman Family Brands, and Maryland franchise owners about the challenges they face and how the bipartisan American Franchise Act will help support their businesses.

Americans are tired of skyrocketing costs, chaos, and a government that serves the powerful over the people.

I spoke with @C4WBAL and @BryanNehman about how the Democratic majority will get to work and deliver. https://t.co/N1G0G8Bzs0

Supreme Court justices serve for life with little accountability.

My ROBE Act will establish 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices to help restore trust in the Court. https://t.co/acauAjdQh1

Rolling back the tariffs and ending this war of choice would put nearly $5,000 back in the pockets of hardworking Americans.

Americans want relief. https://t.co/EN13brNM5Q

Last night, #MD02 voters sent a clear message: it's time to lower costs and fight corruption.

Let's get to work. https://t.co/tZOiVfbaoD

Your vote is your voice. 🗳️ #ElectionDay

Maryland polls close at 8 PM today. To find your polling location and more information, visit https://t.co/lSsyQO6Gie. https://t.co/uAMmwcXuoN

Congratulations to my friend @CalvinBallTeam on his upcoming appointment to lead @my_bccc!

As a former public school teacher, I know Maryland students have a strong advocate in Calvin. I look forward to working together to support students and expand opportunities across our state. https://t.co/TyE5XnpgKV

Investing in access to quality healthcare is essential for Baltimore County families.

Proud to join @umms for the groundbreaking of the new $110 million Center for Outpatient Care at UM St. Joseph Medical Center, bringing outpatient, surgical, rehabilitation, and specialty services together in Towson.

Huge news for Maryland’s 2nd District: the world-famous @TowsonBand is returning to the 101st Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade!

These outstanding student musicians will represent the talent of Baltimore County on the national stage, and I can’t wait to tune in! Congratulations on this incredible accomplishment.
The scariest thing this Halloween? The higher prices you’re paying because of Trump’s tariffs and war in Iran. https://t.co/8it53gS6hW

This month and every month, I’m standing with survivors of domestic violence as we work toward a future free from violence, fear, and abuse.

That’s why I’ve cosponsored a resolution recognizing October as Domestic Violence Awareness Month. Everyone deserves to feel safe. https://t.co/9ccad41QAu

The Maryland Museum of Natural Sciences in Overlea is officially recognized as Maryland’s state Natural History Museum!

This long-awaited designation gives the museum greater credibility to grow its collections and inspire future generations.

I was proud to support this effort as Baltimore County Executive. Special thanks to Senator Carl Jackson & @BaltCoExec for working on the legislation to make this possible!

If you haven’t voted yet, make a plan to vote on Election Day—this Tuesday, November 3!

To help get you to the polls, @mtamaryland is offering free rides across Maryland on all Local Bus, Express Bus, Light Rail, Metro, and Mobility services. 🚌🚈🗳️ https://t.co/w0jUAbWoNW

Grateful to spend this past Sunday morning with the congregation at Immanuel United Church of Christ in Catonsville!

Reverend Tracy Howe delivered a powerful sermon on liberation as the church celebrated 160 years of faith and service. Thank you for the warm welcome and for https://t.co/4IxXYNJ5t0

The price on the shelf should be the price you pay at the register. 🛒

That’s why I joined an effort urging the FTC to investigate retailers that mislead consumers by charging more at checkout than the price displayed on the shelf. You deserve transparency and accountability. https://t.co/57Dqau3bKj

Wow! More than 50 students were interviewed today for my #MD02 service academy nomination!

I’m grateful to the panel of six service academy graduates who volunteered their time to interview these candidates and help select the next generation of service members. Thank you to all https://t.co/lFgQRf9ppi

Justice Kagan, a sitting Supreme Court justice, is sounding the alarm about rulings that threaten our democracy.

The stakes couldn’t be higher, and no justice should hold a seat on the nation’s highest court for life.

That’s why I introduced the ROBE Act to establish 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices and restore accountability and balance to the Court.

More than $3 million back in Marylanders’ pockets! 💰

My team and I have helped constituents across #MD02 recover money they’re owed, from veterans’ disability benefits and Social Security payments to tax refunds and more.

If you’re having trouble with a federal agency, we can https://t.co/wcsFdIVT7e

As a former public school teacher, I know libraries open doors to opportunity.

Great to join @ChrisVanHollen in Essex to celebrate the $2 million in federal funding we secured for the new @bcplinfo branch! Proud to have laid the groundwork for this project as County Executive https://t.co/lDiY0DdRVz

I never expected Congress to be this dysfunctional.

Congress can't even deliver on issues with overwhelming public support, like banning insider stock trading.

In my second term, I'll keep fighting Trump’s corruption and working to make life more affordable.

@DanRodricks https://t.co/uqXp1RAjDi

Expanding job pathways is critical for Marylanders. 

I was proud to work with @Sen_Alsobrooks and @ChrisVanHollen to secure $850K in federal funding for @CarrollCC’s new Ratcliffe Applied Technology and Trades Center. This investment will train students for in-demand jobs and help local businesses find the skilled workers they need to grow.

Democracy works best when people have a meaningful voice in their government.

At a time when partisanship and special-interest influence slow progress, my Direct Democracy Amendment would give American voters the power to pass or repeal federal laws when Congress fails to act on issues with broad public support.
What is in the 3 MILLION Epstein documents that still remain sealed? https://t.co/BSpRcc0jtw

As a father and former public school teacher, I know every child deserves the chance to grow up healthy and reach their full potential. Honored to be named a Defender of Children in the @campaign4kids's 2026 Legislative Scorecard! https://t.co/pGlylEMXOb

Trump promised lower costs. Instead, American families have spent an average of $4,700+ more on goods and services since he took office.

You’re paying for his tariffs and his war. https://t.co/WR1gOywtn0

Democracy only works when people participate, and that starts with making voter registration more accessible. That’s why I introduced the ASSURE Act with @Rep_McBride to meet people where they are by building voter registration into federal services. https://t.co/Te8g0oItKt

Lansdowne High School has a new chapter ahead! Proud to see this $156 million transformation officially open after securing the funding for this project as Baltimore County Executive. 🚌 

@wbaltv11 @BaltCoPS https://t.co/gP3iYB4WA0

Connecting workers with good jobs is common sense.

Thank you to House Small Business Committee Chairman @RepRWilliams and Maryland workforce leaders for joining me at Dwyer Workforce Development in Baltimore to discuss bipartisan solutions to close the skills gap and create pathways to good careers nationwide.

On #IndigenousPeoplesDay, we honor the rich histories, cultures, and contributions of Native Americans. I stand with Indigenous communities in #MD02 and across the country in the ongoing fight for equality. https://t.co/VZMdpMHsP2

Investing in our schools and environment goes hand in hand. The new Deer Park Elementary is Maryland's first net-zero school, producing as much energy as it uses.

Proud to see this effort I started as Baltimore County Executive come to life. Congratulations, Deer Park! 🏫🌎🎒 @BaltCoPS

Preserving our history strengthens #MD02. Great to stop by the 30th annual Baltimore County African American Cultural Festival in Towson! Thank you to everyone whose hard work made this celebration possible, creating opportunities to honor and educate our community. https://t.co/VaCHmUEwPW

Strong neighborhoods start with attainable housing. I joined the Greater Baltimore Board of Realtors for a panel on boosting housing supply and reducing costs for Marylanders. It's exactly why I worked to get my bipartisan RESIDE Act enacted into law. https://t.co/UYMHFC0FtQ

Happy World Teachers' Day! As a former public school teacher, I know firsthand how demanding this profession is. That's why I introduced the REFRESH Act with @RepShontelBrown to address educator burnout, mental health, and retention. True teacher appreciation requires action. https://t.co/98YzEKyRGL

Two simple ways to lower costs:

❌ End the war with Iran.
❌ Repeal the tariffs.

Americans are paying thousands more under Trump. https://t.co/eBPk4YF7hT

Transparency and accountability are fundamental to good government.

I’ve asked for a public dashboard so Marylanders can track the Key Bridge rebuild every step of the way and I’m thankful to @GovWesMoore for making it happen. Getting the bridge built as safely and quickly as possible is a top Maryland and national priority. https://t.co/nmg3Xs3uPM

As extreme weather becomes more frequent, too many Americans can't get the insurance coverage they need to recover.

Proud to introduce the Community Disaster Protection Act alongside @SEEC and @CongressMin to make disaster protection more affordable for high-risk communities. https://t.co/BaCRNVd3xh

As a former @BaltCoPS teacher, I know investing in schools means investing in our future.

Proud to celebrate Lansdowne High School's $156 million expansion, which I helped secure funding for as Baltimore County Executive—one of the largest school investments in our county's history! 🏫

Our Founding Founders knew they were leaving their legacy to generations they’d never meet—and protecting it means being willing to change it for the better when needed. Great to join students at @McDanielCollege to discuss and celebrate Constitution Day! https://t.co/ggdwBvU2zH

Community events like the Essex Day Festival are what make #MD02 special! Proud to celebrate the festival's 51st year and present the organizers with a citation for bringing our community together. https://t.co/cO1ri7vIWQ

Your hard-earned money isn’t a slush fund for the President’s self-promotion.

There are strict rules about using taxpayer resources — and these ads speak volumes about how little Trump cares about those rules and about you. https://t.co/wPJNDdZKh6

From national parks to neighborhood green spaces, our public lands are an essential part of our communities and national heritage. Let’s continue investing in conservation and protecting these shared spaces for future generations. https://t.co/S9Wifk0cJY

Chief Justice Roberts, Justice Barrett, and Justice Kavanaugh were on the Trump-Xi state dinner guest list.

Justices are meant to be independent of the president, not at lavish state dinners with them.

My ROBE Act will help restore fairness and trust. https://t.co/09759kjAO2

The Chesapeake Bay is a national treasure—and Trump just revoked the federal order protecting it.

The full bipartisan Maryland Congressional Delegation is fighting for our Bay. https://t.co/V98ort83vJ

Lupus affects an estimated 1.5 million Americans, and advocacy like @lupusorg's Walk to End Lupus Now makes a real difference.

Great to join our #MD02 community at the Walk to End Lupus Now at Canton Waterfront Park! 💜 https://t.co/jGKPIapMYv

The president is focused on himself, not you.

@NewsCentralCNN https://t.co/yRlgfusiVN

This is unconscionable.

The president has already been abusing the pardon power—now he’s trying to dodge accountability.

The records must be restored, and we must pass my Pardon Integrity Act to rein in this abuse once and for all. https://t.co/WrZSnIsplU
